document:465.text:
Cast the refined teleportation magic on a textbook, and a miniature portal will appear on an illustration, allowing you to explore its world while still listening to the lecture.
If your professor notices you are away, you can teleport back when the chance arises. The portal closes automatically, leaving no trace on the textbook page.
document:465.source_cn:
对课本施展改良的传送门魔法，一扇微缩传送门便会在书页的插图上浮现。可借此在插图中的世界自由穿行，并且能清晰听到课堂里教授的讲解。
若被教授发现离座，可伺机传送回座位。为应对检查，传送门会自动弥合，书页平整如初，不留丝毫皱褶，无人能察觉破绽。

document:473.text:
Ingredients: moonlight moss, invisible grass juice, and a single drop of an owl's tear as it yawns.
Effect: Grants invisibility for one hour after consumption (everyone, including your professor, won't be able to see you). Note: Sneezing will immediately reveal you!
Fun Anecdote: I fell asleep while invisible and woke up locked inside the lecture hall.
document:473.source_cn:
配方：月光苔+隐形草汁液+一滴猫头鹰的哈欠眼泪
效果：饮用后一小时内，便会像背景板一样被所有人无意识忽略（包括点名时的老师）。但注意，如果打喷嚏药效会立刻失效！
趣事备忘：曾被锁在空教室，因为下课铃响起时药剂还没消失，自己不小心睡了过去。
